plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for GWD (GWTT) EPON OLT / ONU devices (enterprise PEN 10072). It reports uptime, per-board CPU, memory and temperature, device temperature, power supply status and temperature, fan status and speed, and interface traffic.
name: Access

metrics.name: device_board_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of each GWD EPON board in percent, from GW-EPON-MIB boardCpuUsage (1.3.6.1.4.1.10072.2.20.1.1.2.1.1.19). Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_board_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of each GWD EPON board in percent, from GW-EPON-MIB boardMemoryUsage (1.3.6.1.4.1.10072.2.20.1.1.2.1.1.20). Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_board_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature of each GWD EPON board in degrees Celsius, from GW-EPON-MIB boardTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.10072.2.20.1.1.2.1.1.10). Values outside -50 to 150 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Device temperature in degrees Celsius per temperatureDeviceIndex, from GW-EPON-DEV-MIB devTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.10072.2.15.1.6.1.1.2). Values outside -50 to 150 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Run status of each power supply from GW-EPON-DEV-MIB powerRunStatus (1.3.6.1.4.1.10072.2.15.1.5.1.1.2). powerOn(3) is normal (1) and powerOff(2) is abnormal (2); empty(1) slots are not reported.

metrics.name: device_psu_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature of each power supply in degrees Celsius, from GW-EPON-DEV-MIB powerTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.10072.2.15.1.5.1.1.3, 1-100).

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Alarm status of each fan from GW-EPON-DEV-MIB devFanAlarmStatus (1.3.6.1.4.1.10072.2.15.1.4.1.1.3). CLEAR(5) is normal (1) and ALARM(1) is abnormal (2).

metrics.name: device_fan_rpm
metrics.description: Rotation speed of each fan in revolutions per minute, from GW-EPON-DEV-MIB devFanRev (1.3.6.1.4.1.10072.2.15.1.4.1.1.5).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
